events.title: 시애틀에서 태어나다
events.description_en: He was born in Seattle, Washington, United States.

events.title: 워싱턴 대학교에서 항공공학을 마치다
events.title_en: He completed aeronautical engineering at the University of Washington
events.description_en: He earned a degree in aeronautical engineering from the University of Washington.

events.title: 해군으로 남태평양에서 복무하다
events.title_en: He served in the Navy in the South Pacific
events.description: 제2차 세계대전 중 미 해군으로 남태평양에서 복무했다.
events.description_en: He served in the US Navy in the South Pacific during the Second World War.

events.title: 보잉에 입사하다
events.description: 보잉에 들어가 이후 평생을 이 회사에서 일했다.
events.description_en: He joined Boeing, where he would spend his entire career.

events.title: 대시80과 707·727·737 개발에 참여하다
events.title_en: He worked on the Dash 80 and the 707, 727, and 737
events.description: 보잉의 초기 제트 여객기 대시80을 비롯해 707, 727, 737 개발에 두루 참여하며 경력을 쌓았다.
events.description_en: He built his career working across Boeing's early jet programs, including the Dash 80 prototype and the 707, 727, and 737.

events.title: 747 프로그램 수석 엔지니어를 맡다
events.title_en: He became chief engineer of the 747 program
events.description: 새 대형 여객기 747 프로그램의 수석 엔지니어를 맡았다. 그가 이끈 개발팀은 '인크레더블스'라는 별명을 얻었다.
events.description_en: He took charge as chief engineer of the new 747 wide-body program. The development team he led earned the nickname 'The Incredibles.'

events.title: 747을 세상에 공개하다
events.description: 구상을 시작한 지 29개월 만에 747을 완성해 공개했다. 당시로선 세계에서 가장 큰 여객기였다.
events.description_en: Twenty-nine months after the program began, the 747 was completed and rolled out. It was, at the time, the largest airliner in the world.

events.title: 국가기술훈장을 받다
events.title_en: He received the National Medal of Technology
events.description_en: He received the National Medal of Technology from President Ronald Reagan.

events.title: 보잉에서 은퇴하다
events.description: 상용기 부문 엔지니어링·제품개발 수석부사장을 끝으로 보잉에서 은퇴했다.
events.description_en: He retired from Boeing after serving as executive vice president for commercial airplane engineering and product development.

events.title: 브레머턴에서 세상을 떠나다
events.description: 워싱턴주 브레머턴에서 아흔다섯의 나이로 세상을 떠났다.
events.description_en: He died in Bremerton, Washington, at the age of ninety-five.
